  • Constructor Details

    • Candidate

      public Candidate(CompositionalReservoirHistory history, double initialVolumeM3, FetkovichAquifer aquifer, double priorMass, String reference)
      Defines one joint prior scenario without running or tuning an EOS.
      Parameters:
      history - common observations and this scenario's measured component realization and accepted EOS
      initialVolumeM3 - positive initial total pore volume, m3
      aquifer - optional immutable physical aquifer; null gives no support
      priorMass - positive finite relative prior probability mass of this complete scenario
      reference - provenance of joint geological/PVT/history assumptions and mass assignment
